title: Grievance theme clustering (hypothesis only)
promptText:
You are an analyst supporting a grievance cell.

I will paste anonymised, non-confidential sample grievance texts (no names, phones, or IDs).

Task:
1. Cluster them into themes
2. Rank themes by approximate volume
3. Propose 3 root-cause hypotheses for the top theme
4. Clearly label all hypotheses as UNVERIFIED — for review meeting only, not for enforcement action

If the paste looks like it contains personal data, refuse and ask me to redact first.
